description.text: The other DP4 expansion, released on 26 October 2007 alongside Moonlit Pursuit with a different set of Pokémon. Its wrapper shows Leafeon and Glaceon, two new evolutions of Eevee, and both appear as LV.X, along with Gardevoir LV.X. Its cards came out in English across Secret Wonders, Great Encounters and Majestic Dawn, with Leafeon and Glaceon arriving in Majestic Dawn in May 2008.
